amendments.finding: The approved FullPath-only approach still bypasses the reference loader and duplicates provider discovery.
amendments.reason: Use the existing registry and update all required test constructors.

amendments.finding: Provider discovery failures are currently dropped and misreported as no provider.
amendments.reason: Use detailed registry results, continue with a found provider, and name incomplete discovery when no provider can be selected.

amendments.finding: Reusing the singleton registry without changing its path-only cache introduces stale providers after same-path workspace reload.
amendments.reason: Bundle the existing cache-lifetime row, key by active reference identity, and test replacement-reference loading.

amendments.finding: Stanza wording and context estimate lagged its widened cache-lifetime scope.
amendments.reason: Align text and estimate with the five-test two-production-file bundle.

amendments.finding: Strong reference-key caching would retain retired analyzer load contexts indefinitely.
amendments.reason: Require weak-key ownership and a collectibility regression alongside same-path behavior.

amendments.finding: Cold review found same-path distinct-reference masking and legacy-constructor diagnostic loss; implementation exposed two stale comments outside listed scope.
amendments.reason: Require identity-based lookup for distinct references, preserve logging, test both regressions, and include the stale-comment edits in the file set.

amendments.finding: Scope estimate text lagged the widened cold-review patch.
amendments.reason: Align stanza estimate with the state entry and 3-production/6-test file scope.

amendments.finding: The plan test used a removable blank line, but the source audit reproduced an inserted blank line after namespace.
amendments.reason: Test the observed insertion shape and preserve outside-range text across boundary and in-range line-count changes.

amendments.finding: The chosen fixture may not actually trigger a formatter line-count change.
amendments.reason: Assert the formatter delta and red old-guard failure before accepting the regression test.

initiatives.notes: Final head 9fda93f8 passed focused Windows/Linux Release suites and independent cold review. Final exact-head current-main integration gate pending; ADR 0012 release choice pending.

amendments.finding: Own and external editorconfig writes both miss invalidation; watcher attribution races and the writer permits outside paths.
amendments.reason: Coordinate owned writes internally, watch config events, validate workspace document ownership, and preserve public contracts.

amendments.finding: A matched document alias could still select an outside config destination; ancestor config changes are outside the current watcher root.
amendments.reason: Derive destination from matched physical document and watch each applicable ancestor directory.

amendments.finding: Cold review found outside-workspace linked and ancestor writes, concurrent external-byte misattribution, alternate-manager bypass, and partial owned-write attribution; DI wiring adds a production file.
amendments.reason: Constrain physical writes, coordinate intended bytes via DI, fail closed without a coordinator, preserve attribution, and list the complete implementation scope.

amendments.finding: The DI file path in the preceding scope amendment did not resolve.
amendments.reason: Use the actual src/RoslynMcp.Roslyn/ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs path in stanza and state.

amendments.finding: Stable set_editorconfig_option now refuses ancestor writes, a public behavior change requiring migration under release policy.
amendments.reason: ADR 0011, decision index, and breaking changelog fragment record the boundary, operator migration, and major-release requirement.

amendments.finding: Cold review: ADR 0011 is reserved for the 5.0 release contract decision
amendments.reason: Editorconfig decision and all plan references now use ADR 0012

amendments.finding: Cold review: separate pre-write byte and line reads can capture different external-edit versions
amendments.reason: One pre-write byte snapshot now supplies both undo and parsing, with a deterministic interleaving regression; bundled exact backlog row

amendments.finding: Hosted undo failure and cold review exposed watcher-delete sharing and lost external-write attribution during owned mutation
amendments.reason: A locked single-handle transaction, delete-sharing watcher reads, and deterministic contention regressions cover the shared write/watch contract

amendments.finding: Cold review: POSIX path replacement returned false success and failed config edits displaced prior undo state
amendments.reason: Condensed plan requires failure on replaced target, successful-write-only undo capture, exact regressions, and dependency-chained remainder

amendments.finding: Linux hosted failure and cold review exposed same-inode contention plus unrecoverable partial-write undo
amendments.reason: Plan now requires held-inode recheck, Linux advisory lock, compensation or explicit recovery record, and tracked external-owner POSIX limit

amendments.finding: Full gate undo failure and cold review exposed shared AtomicFileWriter reader contention, temp collision, path ownership, logger, and lazy parser handles.
amendments.reason: Widened to the complete owned-write mechanism, cross-platform regressions, explicit external-writer residual row, and actual touched file set.

amendments.finding: The new nullable-flow regression exposed a write-only outer-local outflow that generated an unbound identifier.
amendments.reason: Bundle the distinct tracked row into this same file slice and require the declaration fix with compile regression.

amendments.finding: Cold review: narrowing the extracted return can accidentally narrow a generated caller-local var and break downstream nullable assignment
amendments.reason: Approach now preserves the original caller local type and validation requires a downstream-null regression

amendments.finding: Syntax-only fallback on failed target binding can still emit the same self-reference.
amendments.reason: Use semantic symbol identity across documents and fail closed when it is unavailable.

amendments.finding: Unconditional binding requirement rejects valid symbol-free expression replacements observed in the audit.
amendments.reason: Classify expressions; preserve symbol-free rewrites and fail closed only for unresolved symbol-bearing targets.

amendments.finding: Preview inserts satellites but not the target field; a compile-after-apply fixture without the field would fail for the wrong reason.
amendments.reason: Declare the field in the fixture and verify only the satellite insertion contract, including additive public labels.

amendments.finding: Placement-only edits leave WithB referencing an unbound source and tuple Snapshot return signatures stale.
amendments.reason: Generate a matching WithC for the supported pattern, update tuple signatures, and compile applied previews.
